title: learn's false-none rule over a none entry's fetched urls
goal: ql_learn.py turns a none entry whose fetched host and path match a _sources.csv url into an eval finding at stage miss with `expect` the article citing that source most (ties by path) and the source ids in `observed`; test_querylog.py's class TestLearnFalseNone plants one entry whose fetch is a Microsoft Learn page the kb cites (with a locale segment and a trailing slash), one whose fetch the kb does not cite, and one for a code.claude.com page cited with `.md`, and asserts each finding and that a second learn run writes nothing.
